en: Black‑and‑white image of a rural scene with a uniformed mailman walking along a dirt driveway carrying letters and a bag toward a small wooden house. A mid‑century car is parked beside the house. In the foreground on the right is the front of a postal van bearing a crown emblem and a stylized post horn. Forested hills and a mountain rise in the background, suggesting a northern countryside.
